cross_trace_observation: Both sources contain seed identifiers 0 and 1.
The step trace extends to step 8000, while the archived detailed gradient trace extends to step 1500.
All 347 grad_stats payloads parsed as Python literal dictionaries without executing them.
The traces establish that logging occurred; they do not independently establish model quality or generalization.
privacy_and_scope: No model weights, training corpus, validation corpus, or raw tensor values are admitted.
Only aggregate ranges and counts are retained.
The raw CSV files remain excluded because they are operational data rather than registry metadata.
